name: NumPy
purpose: Fast arrays and maths. Most data and machine learning libraries are built on it.
version_guidance: Install the latest release that supports your Python version. Record the installed version in your research log.

windows.text: Open a terminal in your project folder and activate your virtual environment first.

macos.text: Open a terminal in your project folder and activate your virtual environment first.

linux.text: Open a terminal in your project folder and activate your virtual environment first.

windows.expected: One line: numpy and its version, for example numpy 2.x.y. ModuleNotFoundError means it is not installed in the active environment.

macos.expected: One line: numpy and its version, for example numpy 2.x.y. ModuleNotFoundError means it is not installed in the active environment.

linux.expected: One line: numpy and its version, for example numpy 2.x.y. ModuleNotFoundError means it is not installed in the active environment.

common_problems.solution: Your virtual environment is probably not active, or the package went into another Python. Activate the environment, then install again with python -m pip install.

manual_review: Verification command prints a label before the version so the check is specific to this package. It uses the package's standard __version__ attribute and is not quoted from the official page.
